Original (OFR 1974 Hoover PEO vol. II p. 993) read in full: introductory authorization plus (a) addition to section 15 and (b) instruction rewriting section 20 with the new text; the three scopes (1322-1420, 1421-1467, 1468-1925) cover all operative text. EO 8189 (4 FR 2783) read in full: 'Revocation of Executive Orders ... Executive Order No. 5624 dated May 15, 1931; Executive Order No. 5707 dated September 4, 1931'. EO 8189 has no effective-date sentence; the 'effective on July 1, 1939' sentences on the same page belong to EOs 8190 and 8191, so 1939-07-05 (signing; filed 1939-07-06) is correct. No savings clause. Earlier-end test: no held instrument amends EO 5624 secs. 15/20 after 1931; EO 7968 (1938) V-39 still cites 'Regulations ... prescribed by Executive Order No. 5624 ..., as amended' as current, and EO 8297/8298 (Dec. 1939) delete that cross-reference after the revocation, which corroborates continuity to 1939-07-05. No 1931-1939 APP title amends the quarters regulations. Caveat: original_pages_confirmed=false; EO 7013 (1935, revoked in the same list) text not held, but its title concerns the Instructions/Consular Regulations, not the EO 5624 quarters regulations.

Verified EO 7968 'EXECUTIVE ORDERS SUPERSEDED' names No. 5812 of Feb. 29, 1932; dossier lacks an evidence record for that provision ('target provision not located: EO:7968'), so no end can be cited. Correct.

Inventory (lead sentence 890-1163 and substituted paragraph (d) 1164-1820) is complete and EO 8189 does name EO 5825 with no effective-date sentence or savings clause, but the earlier-end test is not closed, so 'no earlier end' and unresolved_material_gaps=[] are unsupported. (1) Held EO 7845 (Mar. 21, 1938, 3 FR 715; 'effective as of January 1, 1938', superseding EO 7409 of July 9, 1936) prescribes annual-leave regulations for all civilian officers and employees under the Annual Leave Act of Mar. 14, 1936 (49 Stat. 1161); it does not except the Foreign Service (sec. 19), sec. 16 lets departments apply it to employees abroad, sec. 9 forbids leave without pay until accumulated and current accrued leave is exhausted, sec. 13 governs non-pay status at year-end and annual leave at the start of the next calendar year, and sec. 20 revokes 'all other regulations relating to the granting of annual leave ... in so far as they are inconsistent'. That reaches the exact subject of paragraph (d) (leave without salary to the end of the calendar year so that the next year's paid leave is available) and may be a partial earlier end on 1938-01-01 (or under EO 7409 / EO 7321 temporary regulations in 1936). EO 8189 itself (IV-11) replaces the provision with 'statutory leave subject to regulations prescribed by the Secretary of State', consistent with the 1936 statutes already governing. The producer acknowledged this as an open question for the reviewer but recorded no gap. (2) EO 7013 (Apr. 16, 1935, 'Amendment of Instructions to Diplomatic Officers and of Consular Regulations'), revoked in the same EO 8189 list, is not held and was not checked; other unheld 1934-1937 amendments of the Instructions/Consular Regulations (EOs 6810-A, 6942, 7261-A, 7449, 7497) also may touch ch. VI sec. 8 / sec. 467. (3) The OFR catalog search starts in 1937, so the cited searches cannot cover 1932-1936. Required: hold and read EO 7013, EO 7409/7321 and the 1936 Annual Leave Act text (applicability to the Foreign Service), decide whether paragraph (d) ended (in whole or in part) before 1939-07-05, and record the result or the gap.

EO 8512 (5 FR 2849) read in full: sec. 9 revokes 'Executive Orders No. 5614 of May 1, 1931 ...' by number; EO 8512 has no effective-date sentence and no savings clause, so 1940-08-13 (signing; filed 1940-08-14) is correct for all three clauses. The FULL_AND_PARTIAL conflict is correctly resolved: the generic 'parts thereof inconsistent' tail does not narrow the named whole revocation. Earlier-end test: no held instrument amends EO 5614; related orders 6226, 6869, 7126 (texts not held) are revoked in the same sentence, i.e. they coexisted with EO 5614 until 1940, and no 1931-1940 title in the APP index purports to amend or revoke EO 5614. The OFR catalog search cannot cover 1931-1936, so the pre-1937 gap rests on this index/title review plus the revoking order's own recital, which is adequate for an AI-level uphold but not a substitute for human certification.
